events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What was your festival highlight from '69?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: Long Live the King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and legacy continue to shake up the world. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering an icon
angles.copy: Thirty years since the hip-hop world lost Tupac Shakur. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we said goodbye to Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring iconic tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic album, iconic cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from their final recorded album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude are timeless.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the outspoken former frontman of Oasis and solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine all the people
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's powerful message of peace, 'Imagine', hit the UK charts. A song that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music and carry our favourite tunes.

angles.name: The music revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped a game-changer that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you own?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 64th anniversary of the premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His legacy as a musician and peace activist endures.

angles.name: A true legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: A national treasure
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ambitious double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: The sound of '68
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their sprawling 'White Album'. Which track from this diverse masterpiece is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and spirit remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
